faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about mobile menu management.

items.question: Do I need to install an app?
items.answer: No. The dashboard works in your phone's web browser — Safari, Chrome, or any other. Just log in and start managing your menu.

items.question: Can I do everything from my phone that I can on a computer?
items.answer: Yes. Every feature is available on mobile — adding items, uploading photos, managing categories, checking analytics, handling orders and reservations.

items.question: Does it work on tablets too?
items.answer: Yes. The dashboard adapts to any screen size — phones, tablets, and desktop computers. Use whichever device is most convenient.

items.question: Can multiple people manage the menu?
items.answer: Currently one account manages the restaurant. You can log in from multiple devices simultaneously — your phone, tablet, or computer.
